name: Shenzhen Sinexcel Electric Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Sinexcel Electric Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of power electronic equipment and solutions in China and internationally. The company offers industrial supporting power supply products, such as active power filter, static VAR generator, three-phase unbalanced regulators, dynamic power regulators, low-voltage line voltage regulator, uninterruptible power supply, and high-voltage static VAR generators. It also provides energy power conversion equipment products, including energy storage converters, DC converters, inverter-boost integrated cabins, and prefabricated cabinet-type and box-type semi-integrated energy storage systems.
